title: Instrument token-phase entropy and add compact invocation micro-digests with alert-slope auto-tuner
author: Laura Chen
release_notes: Add per-token-phase entropy histograms and compact invocation micro-digests. Introduce alert-slope auto-tuner to reduce noisy SLO churn. Backwards-compatible telemetry additions only.
description:
Context: We observe recurring noisy SLO alerts driven by rare, phase-specific token behavior (e.g. bursts when decoding long histories). Existing token-cost and latency metrics capture counts and percentiles but do not surface intra-invocation phase disorder. Motivation: Surface a lightweight per-token-phase entropy signal and compact invocation micro-digests so engineers can quickly identify whether a cost/latency spike is due to increased entropy (less predictable token distributions) versus kernel/backpressure issues. This PR introduces three parts: 1) token-phase entropy histogram metric emitted from the runtime; 2) compact invocation micro-digests (sharded, bounded summaries) attached to sampled traces for quick triage without full KV payloads; 3) an alert-slope auto-tuner that adjusts SLO thresholds dynamically based on short-term entropy baselines to reduce alert noise.

Changes: - Runtime: new runtime counter and histogram for per-token-phase Shannon entropy (phases: init, prefix, gen, postprocess). Exposes labels: model, route, tenant, device_pool, phase, seq_len_bucket. The histogram is coarse (8 buckets) to control cardinality. - Trace attachment: a new compact JSON micro-digest (<= 2KB) includes: token_count, entropy_estimate, avg_token_delay_ms, kernel_wait_ms, top3-token-shapes. Micro-digests are attached only to sampled traces (configurable sampling rate). - Alerting: add a new observability service module that consumes entropy rollups and computes short-window slope. When slope exceeds threshold, the module temporarily widens alert thresholds for affected routes to avoid immediate firing; it records decisions to an audit metric.

Checklist: - [x] Runtime metric emission and unit tests - [x] Micro-digest schema, serializer, and bounded size test - [x] Collector side aggregation and dashboard panels - [x] Alert-slope auto-tuner implementation + e2e integration tests - [x] Docs snippet in observability guide (short) - [x] QA: smoke runs on staging with 48h replay workload

Commits summary: - Add entropy estimator and histogram emission (runtime/metrics) - Add micro-digest serializer and attach logic in trace exporter - Add collector rollup pipeline and short-window slope calculator - Implement alert-slope auto-tuner and config knobs - Add dashboard panels and runbook notes - Tests and small docs

High-level changed files: - runtime/src/metrics/entropy.rs (new) - runtime/tests/entropy_estimator_test.rs (new) - trace-exporter/src/microdigest.rs (new) - collector/rollups/entropy_roller.go (new) - observability/alerting/slope_tuner.py (new) - dashboards/entropy-and-microdigests.json (new panel) - docs/observability/token-entropy.md (docs) - e2e/replay/fixtures/entropy-replay.yaml (test fixture) - CI: update pipeline to include new e2e job

Review conversation: - Carlos Martinez (review): "Can we bound the cardinality here? labels like tenant+route+model can explode." - Author (Laura): "Bounded buckets (8) + seq_len bucketing implemented; micro-digests are sampled; added aggressive TTL on metric cardinality. See runtime/metrics/entropy.rs lines ~120 for bucket logic." - Rohit Nair (review): "How do we ensure this doesn't add CPU overhead in hot paths?" - Author: "Entropy estimator uses incremental one-pass estimator with tiny state per invocation; micro-digests are emitted asynchronously by the trace-exporter to avoid blocking inference threads. Benchmark added in entropy_estimator_test shows <2% CPU at p95 under load." - Priya Patel (review): "Operator controls for the alert-tuner? need explanation and safe defaults." - Author: "Added tunable knobs: enable_flag=false by default, slope_window=5m, cooldown=10m, max_widen_pct=25. Documented in docs/observability/token-entropy.md. Also feature-flagged for staged rollout." - Carlos: "Approved after clarifying cardinality and sampling defaults." - Rohit: "Approved after seeing microbenchmark results." - Priya: "Approved with request to land runbook note; added in PR." 

CI checks: - unit (linux): passed - lint: passed - integration (collector): passed - e2e entropy replay: passed (staging job) - docs build: passed - security scan: passed

Operational notes & runbook excerpt: - Default rollout: disabled in hosted; enabled for Dedicated/Private staging by flag. - Sampling default: 1% of traces; can increase for canaries. - Alert-slope tuner defaults: disabled; when enabled starts with conservative widen_pct=10. - If alerts are still noisy, increase sample rate for micro-digests on affected route and create a follow-up to add per-model baselines (linked ENG-9051). - Storage: micro-digests are not persisted beyond 72h by default to limit storage.

Related: ENG-8420 (investigate noisy SLOs from token-phase bursts), ENG-9051 (follow-up: per-model baselining), INF-510 (ops request for compact trace payloads).

Merge outcome: Squash-merged to main after approvals. Backported a small patch to release/2026-02 to support a dedicated-customer canary; that cherry-pick landed as hotfix commit 7a1f4b3.
